text:
Priya N.: SIN terminal flagged 6x H200s on PO 2480 — firmware mismatch on arrival. customs put a hold pending vendor inspection.
Zenith Supply Rep: Confirmed. Factory parallel imaging caused mixed build ids (v1.2.0 / v1.2.1). Carrier scanned batches separately, triggering QA hold.
Tom H.: Can depot flash locally or does customs require vendor-signed inspection to clear import paperwork?
Luca (Logistics): Customs demands vendor-signed inspection for firmware variance before release. Depot can flash but won't clear customs docs without vendor sign-off. Storage starts after 48h: ~SGD 120/day.
Alyssa - Procurement: Options/costs? If we request replacements from SG buffer, expedited fee?
Zenith Supply Rep: Options:
A) 4x matched-firmware replacements from SG buffer tomorrow AM, vendor covers freight, expedite fee USD 2.5k/unit.
B) Depot flash in SIN (3	6d) vendor covers depot labor, you cover customs broker uplift (~SGD 600) + storage if >48h.
C) RMA return-to-factory (~3w).
Priya N.: We need capacity for APAC benchmark Wed. Could we take 2 loaners short-term?
Zenith Supply Rep: We can loan 2 refurbished H200s for 72h (LOAN-SIN-01/02) at no charge under loaner SLA. Temp serials will be used.
Tom H.: Benchmarks okay on loaners. Procurement: can ledger accept temp serials for 72h?
Alyssa - Procurement: Yes, but need PO amendment LOAN-2480 and signed asset handoff. Vendor must provide build manifests and per-unit firmware hashes.
ops-bot: Event: PO 2480 - HOLD - SIN Terminal QA flag. AWB SGN-555-001.
Priya N.: Manifest snippet:
```
PO: 2480-RED
AWB: SGN-555-001
SKU: H200-80GB
QTY: 6
Destination: SIN Depot B2
```
Luca (Logistics): Practical ask: depot flash (B) cheapest if vendor covers labor, but broker + storage still on us unless vendor concedes.
Zenith Supply Rep: We'll cover depot labor and tests if you accept split shipment + loaners. Cannot reimburse customs broker under standard contract, but will issue commercial credit request.
Tom H.: Vendor must upload firmware checksums and signed manifests within 12h so customs has evidence. Also depot photos of serials at handoff.
Zenith Supply Rep: Affirmative. We'll upload SHA256 hashes, signed build manifests, and photos within 12h and provide chain-of-custody doc.
Alyssa - Procurement: Finance note: push vendor for credit on broker uplift; prepare PO amendment and route for signatures.
Priya N.: Decision: accept loaners (2), approve split shipment with 4 replacements shipping tomorrow, vendor covers freight and depot labor, we cover broker for now and escalate for credit. Condition: vendor must provide manifests, checksums, and photos within 24h.
Zenith Supply Rep: Confirmed. Loaners LOAN-SIN-01/02 assigned. Replacement AWB SGN-777-888 ETA 08:45 SGT tomorrow. We'll upload artifacts to shared folder.
ops-bot: Event: Replacement AWB created SGN-777-888 ETA 08:45 SGT.
Luca (Logistics): Tag runbooks: apac-alloc-fallback + loaner-checklist. I'll monitor storage timer and broker invoices.
Tom H.: Postmortem action: add firmware build_id validation to procurement manifest checks to prevent mixed-batch shipments.
Priya N.: noted. :memo:
